subject: general
question: Six friends T, V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. V sits second to the right of Y. Y sits to the immediate left of T. X sits second to the left of W. How many people sit between Z and V when counted from the left of V?
solution:
Given: Six friends T, V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) V sits second to the right of Y.

2) Y sits to the immediate left of T.

3) X sits second to the left of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37bea56ad4d7d194218f8d82fb4b49c36460b00e32de33e55029337f69e7ca35.png] 

Here, There are **Three** people siting between Z and V when counted from the left of V.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
